title: Docs: Proofreading for grammar and spelling (Salvages #112123)
body:
Minor cases with confusion over `it's`, `its`, and the possessive, using https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/112123.
Plus other typo fixes, rewording, grammatical errors and improvements.

This combines and updates the work from #112123 with additional fixes, such as lexical and grammatical errors, typos, code example issues, more brief sentences and rewording where it makes sense.

- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/91521

## Why am i using #112123?

Because the original PR is so old, that while it can rebase to current master without any problems, i can't PR to their branch (i tried), so i am currently doing the backup plan of PR-ing directly to the Godot engine instead.

PR-ing my changes by ignoring these is just not an option as this will create a lot of extra translation and conflict resolve work.

What i have done is rebase #112123 to master (no conflicts), cherry-pick my changes on top and resolve all conflicts by taking AThousandShips' preferences rather than mine.

### Closes:

- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/112123 (salvage)
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/115768 (incorporated in this PR)
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/120179 (incorporated in this PR)

## Additional information

AI was used to find the needles in this haystack, but was NOT used to pull them out. I wrote everything by hand and thought about my decisions. I do not use agents.

I do not expect this to be merged now, right as 4.7 is about to release.
